description:
Title: Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine

You develop an application that helps you with the inspection of a machine.
After entering the type of the machine, and its serial number, the inspection can begin:
* Questions are asked, and you have to input values.
* Buttons are to be pressed, and values are automatically collected from the machine and shown to you.
* Depending on the results, additional questions are asked (or not).

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_EnergyDrinkInspection" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/energy-drink-bottling-machine-inspection">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MachineInspection" name="Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_InspectionStart" name="Inspection started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToEnterMachine</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterMachineData" name="Enter machine type and serial number">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToEnterMachine</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterMachineToQuestions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AnswerQuestions" name="Answer inspection questions and input values">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterMachineToQuestions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_QuestionsToButton</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PressButton" name="Press machine button">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_QuestionsToButton</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ButtonToCollect</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CollectMachineValues" name="Collect and show machine values">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ButtonToCollect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CollectToDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions_Split" name="Results require additional questions?" default="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CollectToDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_YesAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions" name="Answer additional questions and input values">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_YesAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions_Join" name="Inspection continues">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_InspectionCompleted" name="Inspection completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToEnterMachine" sourceRef="StartEvent_InspectionStart" targetRef="Task_EnterMachineData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterMachineToQuestions" sourceRef="Task_EnterMachineData" targetRef="Task_AnswerQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_QuestionsToButton" sourceRef="Task_AnswerQuestions" targetRef="Task_PressButton"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ButtonToCollect" sourceRef="Task_PressButton" targetRef="Task_CollectMachineValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectToDecision" sourceRef="Task_CollectMachineValues" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_YesAdditionalQuestions" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions_Split" targetRef="Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions_Split" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalToMerge" sourceRef="Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions_Join" targetRef="EndEvent_InspectionCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
